why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Probable points page Go to the Probable points page , which lists the four ways to earn and marks each as Live.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Link your wallet from the points page. Once it is connected, you can generate your own referral code.
3 Step 3 : Trade on active markets Place orders on markets listed on Probable . Trading rewards go to activity on active markets, and higher-quality trading earns more points.
4 Step 4 : Provide liquidity and hold positions Keep orders near the market price on both outcomes for liquidity rewards, and hold active positions over time for open interest rewards.
5 Step 5 : Invite friends with your referral code Generate your referral code and share it. Points from invites depend on the trading volume of the people who join through it.
6 Step 6 : Read the migration notice Read the predict.fun post on X linked from the site banner, which covers the fee refund and the conversion to Predict Points.
